description: Connect a trusted remote HTTPS MCP server, review its tools, and scope each tool to projects.
Search logs through the Elastic connection already managed by Nexus.

capabilities.label: Search approved Elastic logs
capabilities.purpose: Run one bounded search over this project's selected Elastic sources. Pass short search terms, not the whole user question. The same observation includes exact-query matches plus per-source freshness and coverage, so it is authoritative for that query and scope.
use_when: The user asks for Elastic evidence. Call once with short literal search terms or OR alternatives, not the whole user question, then answer from the returned matches and coverage diagnosis.
do_not_use_when: Do not retry an empty result with synonyms, ERROR alone, or * unless the user explicitly requests another search. Do not fall back to TMC, runtime evidence, documentation, or another provider when the request is specifically about Elastic unless the user explicitly broadens the request.
The user asks for design documentation, field mappings, or business rules; search project documentation instead.
preconditions: The existing Elastic connection is healthy and the project has an explicit source grant.

failure_recovery.unavailable: Explain that Elastic is not enabled for this project and direct the owner to Connectors.
failure_recovery.failed: Report the safe failure. Do not retry or switch evidence providers unless the user explicitly asks.

config_schema.project_source_contexts: discovered safe field roles per project

capabilities.label: Search fixture knowledge
capabilities.purpose: Search bounded records from one authorized fixture-knowledge connector.
use_when: The user asks for evidence held by this configured fixture connector.
do_not_use_when: The request concerns Nexus documentation or runtime evidence instead.
preconditions: The server bound an eligible connector instance to this request.

failure_recovery.unavailable: Report that the connector is unavailable without inventing evidence.
failure_recovery.failed: Report the safe failure and retry only when marked retryable.

description: Search an approved PostgreSQL view with enforced project filtering.

capabilities.label: Search approved database view
capabilities.purpose: Search one owner-approved PostgreSQL view scoped to the bound Nexus project.
use_when: The user asks for live data held by the configured PostgreSQL view.
do_not_use_when: The answer is available in Nexus documentation or runtime evidence.
preconditions: The connector is healthy and bound to the selected project.

failure_recovery.unavailable: Report that the database connector is unavailable.
failure_recovery.failed: Report the safe failure without inventing rows.
